definitions.aggregation: medians over tasks; no cross-task score mixing
definitions.delta_pct: normalized percentile (1=best) of a true positive in the new model minus the reference model; positive = new model ranks it higher
definitions.spearman: per task, Pearson correlation of average ranks of raw logits on observed molecules
definitions.topk: K1=ceil(0.01*n_observed), K5=ceil(0.05*n_observed), ties broken by ascending official row id

warnings: High Spearman only indicates similar global ordering; negatives dominate most tasks and can drive it.
Exclusive high-ranked positives are not a net gain: reference-only positives are reported alongside.
Test is an exposed comparison set; all numbers are descriptive.
